source: Curated by hand from measured parses. The machine nominates, a human rules.
why: A mob that reflects is not automatically a mob worth a row. Nine mobs in
the corpus reflect something; on most of them the raid neither notices nor
cares, and a countdown that appears for those is a countdown people learn
to ignore. So this file is an ALLOWLIST, the same shape of decision as
decides, and an unlisted mob gets nothing rather than a guess.
window_s is measured, not configured — see docs/live.md. Add a mob here
only with the measurement that justifies it in `note`.

Treyloth D'Kulvith.note: 18 windows across 6 kills, every one 28-31s, three per kill at roughly 75%/50%/25% health. The reflect returns the spell to its CASTER (113 of 115 paired returns) and at p90 costs that caster 79% of their max health, 96.8% at worst - which is why this one earns a row and Mayong's (p90 22.7%, never above 26%) does not.
